exposure: Robson Ten Group Classification System criteria
Indications for Caesarean section (e.g., fetal distress, CPD, breech, multiple pregnancies, severe oligohydramnios, prior CS)
outcome: Classification of Caesarean section cases by Robson's criteria
Analysis of indications for Caesarean section
cohort: The study included 454 pregnant women who underwent Caesarean section at a teaching hospital from January to December 2023.
finding: Caesarean section rates were notably high in repeat CS cases and primary procedures, specifically within Robson Groups 5 (42.3%), 2 (25.1%), and 1 (14.5%).
mod_finding: Caesarean section was the mode of birth for all included participants, with high rates observed in repeat CS (Group 5) and primary procedures in nulliparous women (Groups 2 and 1).
